local report = game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("CornAudioLiveReport")
assert(report, "No live observer result")
local raw = game.HttpService:JSONDecode(report.Value)
local roles, stateChanges, hunt, cricketSegments = {}, {}, {}, {}
local lastState
for _, sample in raw.samples do
 if sample.state ~= lastState then table.insert(stateChanges,{at=sample.at,state=sample.state,target=sample.target});lastState=sample.state end
 for _, sound in sample.sounds do
  local role=sound.role
  local entry=roles[role] or {loaded=false,playingSamples=0,maxPosition=0,maxLoudness=0,maxVolume=0}
  roles[role]=entry
  entry.loaded=entry.loaded or sound.loaded
  if sound.playing then entry.playingSamples+=1 end
  entry.maxPosition=math.max(entry.maxPosition,sound.pos)
  entry.maxLoudness=math.max(entry.maxLoudness,sound.loudness)
  entry.maxVolume=math.max(entry.maxVolume,sound.volume)
  if role=="Hunt" and (sound.playing or sample.state=="chase" or (#hunt>0 and sample.at-hunt[#hunt].at<3)) then table.insert(hunt,{at=sample.at,playing=sound.playing,volume=sound.volume,pos=sound.pos,state=sample.state}) end
  if role and role:sub(1,8)=="crickets" then
   local segments=cricketSegments[sound.path] or {}
   cricketSegments[sound.path]=segments
   local previous=segments[#segments]
   if not previous or previous.playing~=sound.playing then table.insert(segments,{at=sample.at,playing=sound.playing,pos=sound.pos}) end
  end
 end
end
return game.HttpService:JSONEncode({done=raw.done,duration=raw.samples[#raw.samples].at,events=raw.events,roles=roles,stateChanges=stateChanges,hunt=hunt,cricketSegments=cricketSegments})
